critiques.claim: Natural language is ambiguous, while test-case language is unambiguous.
critiques.critique: Test case examples reduce ambiguity but can still omit dimensions, encode wrong business assumptions, describe implementation details instead of outcomes, or fail to define behavior outside selected cases.
critiques.nuance: Executable BDD scenarios significantly improve shared understanding over raw prose — the claim is over-stated, not wrong in direction.
